Bridge Retrofit Engineer said about it: This matches the finding in the Pedestrian Bridge Dynamics: Footfall-Induced Vibration and Damping (E22) that the most direct fix once a resonance-sensitive frequency is identified is usually to add damping rather than to redesign the whole structure, and the finding in the Keep to the beat: The Physics of Spontaneous Synchronization (E23) that increasing stiffness was considered impractical because it required major structural additions, significant added mass, aesthetic impact and high cost.
